questions.prompt: You relabel 24 kHz samples as 12 kHz without resampling. What happens?
questions.explanation: Changing the declared rate changes how fast existing samples play. Resampling computes new samples.

questions.prompt: Why can a mel spectrogram not directly recover the exact original waveform?
options: It is already an audio codec bitstream
It contains too many exact samples
questions.explanation: Magnitude/mel representations discard phase and compress frequency detail. Reconstruction needs additional assumptions or a model.

questions.prompt: A voice sounds clear on headphones. What else matters for telephone delivery?
options: Listen through the target telephone channel
Only increase the output sample rate
questions.explanation: The target channel changes what the caller hears. Evaluate the delivered audio, not only the studio output.
